name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.20
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.20）

这一版主要修复微信视频号、朋友圈「先给几分钟」的问题，并把「等一会儿」固定为 15 分钟。

**修复：时间用完时涟漪崩溃，之后不再拦截**

视频号、朋友圈设成「先给几分钟」后，免费时间用完的那一刻，「时间到了」页面一打开涟漪就会崩溃。崩溃后系统会把涟漪的无障碍服务停掉，设置里看着还开着，实际上已经不工作，之后视频号、朋友圈和其他限制都不再拦截，要重装或重新开关无障碍才恢复。这一版修好了，时间用完会正常弹出「时间到了」页面。

**修复：刷视频时弹出的东西打断识别**

刷视频号时出现广告浮层、评论区、通知栏或输入法，涟漪会把它们当成当前页面，认不出还在视频号里，于是不计时、不拦截。现在涟漪会记住微信里最近一个真正的页面，这些弹出的东西不会再把它替换掉。无障碍服务重新连上时，也会用系统使用记录补上当前页面。

**修复：「回到微信聊天」回到了桌面**

在「时间到了」页面中途按过 Home 键再回来，点「回到微信聊天」会回到桌面。现在会直接打开微信首页，不会回到视频号或朋友圈。

**改动：「等一会儿」固定 15 分钟**

设置里调「等一会儿」时长的选项去掉了。放松规则前一律等 15 分钟，抖音这类 App 仍是双倍 30 分钟。以前改成 30 分钟、1 小时或 2 小时的，升级后也按 15 分钟算。引导页和说明文字里「时长可以改」的说法也一并删掉。

**界面和文字**

「应用限制」改名为「自律APP」，列表标题改为「已添加自律的 App」。「今天」页的使用卡片改为显示今天总时长、近 7 天柱状图和用得最多的 3 个 App。「今天拦下」改为整行显示。「限制网址」的叫法在各处统一。列表行的说明缩短，大字号下每日时长、休息规则和打开次数也能看全。界面文字里的破折号去掉，英文的 1 次解锁、等待时长说明等几处文字已修正。

已知限制：视频号的计时和「时间到了」页面已在一台 OPPO 手机上用真实微信测过。「回到微信聊天」这次的修复只有单元测试，还没有在真机上用真实微信测，会在之后补测。朋友圈这次没有测。小米手机没有复测。部分手机打开受限应用时，仍可能短暂露脸。

iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。签名证书没有变，已经装了旧版的可以直接覆盖升级。

## What's New (Android v0.1.20)

This release fixes "Allow a few min" for WeChat Channels and Moments, and fixes the "Wait a moment" time at 15 minutes.

**Fixed: Ripple crashed when the time ran out, and then stopped blocking**

With Channels or Moments set to "Allow a few min", Ripple crashed the moment the free time ran out and the time-up page opened. After the crash, the system stopped Ripple's accessibility service. Settings still showed it as on, but it no longer worked, so Channels, Moments, and other limits were not blocked until Ripple was reinstalled or accessibility was turned off and on again. This is fixed, and the time-up page now opens normally.

**Fixed: pop-ups while watching interrupted detection**

When an ad overlay, the comment panel, the notification shade, or the keyboard appeared in Channels, Ripple treated it as the current page. It could no longer tell you were still in Channels, so it did not count time or block. Ripple now remembers the last real WeChat page, and these pop-ups no longer replace it. When the accessibility service reconnects, Ripple also uses system usage records to fill in the current page.

**Fixed: "Back to WeChat chats" went to the home screen**

If you pressed Home while the time-up page was open and then came back, tapping "Back to WeChat chats" took you to the home screen. It now opens the WeChat main screen directly and does not go back to Channels or Moments.

**Changed: "Wait a moment" is fixed at 15 minutes**

The setting for the "Wait a moment" length has been removed. Relaxing a rule always waits 15 minutes, and high-risk apps such as Douyin still wait twice as long, 30 minutes. If you had changed it to 30 minutes, 1 hour, or 2 hours, it counts as 15 minutes after the update. Onboarding and help text no longer say the length can be changed.

**Screens and wording**

The "App Limits" tab has a new Chinese name, and the list title is now "Added apps". The usage card on the Today page now shows today's total time, a 7-day bar chart, and your top 3 apps. "Blocked Today" now uses a full row. "Website Limits" is now named the same way everywhere. List descriptions are shorter, so daily limits, break rules, and open counts fit at large font sizes. Dashes were removed from screen text, and several English strings were corrected, including the one-time unlock and the wait time descriptions.

Known limits: Channels time counting and the time-up page were tested on an OPPO phone with real WeChat. The "Back to WeChat chats" fix is covered by unit tests only and has not yet been tested on a real phone with real WeChat. That test will follow. Moments was not tested in this release. This build has not been retested on a Xiaomi phone. On some phones, a restricted app may still flash briefly when opened.

The iPhone app is unchanged and remains v0.1.5. The signing certificate is unchanged, so you can install this over an older version.
